comment: Generated maps (DESIGN 6.2): a pool map has no terrain (its WDT holds only a global WMO, out of sight, for the
client's zone lookup). mod-atlas builds a layout of kit pieces in each instance: stock WMOs placed as
gameobjects (type 14, MAP_OBJECT), joined socket to socket (src/AtlasKit.h). A piece's display must be in the
server's vmaps/GameObjectModels.dtree (gameobject collision) and its WMO in the client.
A socket is a point on a piece's edge, in the WMO's own frame (yards), with the direction it faces out of the
piece (degrees, counter-clockwise from +x). Two pieces join with a socket on a socket, facing apart. Find them
with tools/clones/wmofloor.py (floor map, floor heights along a portal).
map.origin is where the start piece goes (x, y, z, facing in degrees); max_pieces caps a layout.
Reserved IDs: maps 950-999, MapDifficulty 754+ (759 here), gameobject entries 900100-900199 (kit pieces),
AreaTable 7900-7949. The area is the map's zone for client and server (name, music, ambience; no rest or
sanctuary flags). It copies its template's sounds (2366 The Black Morass) and has an explore bit no other area

sockets.comment: apron outside the mouth, 17.5 yd out (wmofloor.py --portal 1 --out 17.5)
